# Paths Version Roadmap

Purpose: keep one canonical list of Paths versions and the feature scope for each release.

> Partly stale (checked 2026-10-08). The last App Store Connect record (`app_store/SETUP_STATUS.md`,
> 2026-09-09) shows iOS version 1.0 in Prepare for Submission with no build uploaded, so no version had
> reached the App Store then, whatever the "Shipped" row below says. The project's marketing version is
> 1.0.1 (build 2), and the Q2 and Q3 2026 target windows below have passed. The plans are kept as

## Versioning Rules

- Use semantic versioning: `major.minor.patch`.
- Increase `patch` for bug fixes, release engineering updates, and no-scope-change submissions.
- Increase `minor` for net-new user-facing features that are backward compatible.
- Increase `major` for major product surface expansions or intentional compatibility breaks.

## Version Details

### 1.0.0 (Historical Baseline)

Status: shipped

Target window: historical

Release owner: founding iOS team (historical)

Changelog:

Completed in this version:

- Core product loop: schedule patterns, execute methods, publish proof, review progression.
- Initial PATH score model foundations.
- Primary app surfaces established: Schedule, Feed, Arete, Progress, Profile.

Planned/deferred at end of this version:

- Broader community expansion work and groups-at-scale operations (deferred to later versions).

### 1.0.1 (Current Baseline)

Status: active baseline (`MARKETING_VERSION = 1.0.1`, `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = 2`)

Target window: Q2 2026

Release owner: current release lead (TBD by team)

Changelog:

Completed in this version:

- Release readiness artifacts and QA hardening (regression, smoke, visual checks).
- Progression data reliability improvements across local state and Supabase sync.
- Method publish-to-progression linkage hardening (publish completion to points to progress sync).
- PATH score integrity improvements in Progress and shared snapshot refresh flow.

Explicit product scope notes:

- Groups remains in the codebase but is outside active v1 core navigation scope.

Planned/carry-over after this version:

- Remaining blocker and compliance closure work moved to 1.1.0 stabilization scope.

### 1.1.0 (Planned)

Status: planned

Target window: Q3 2026 target

Release owner: stability lane owner (TBD by team)

Changelog:

Completed pre-work before version start:

- Shared PATH score and progression pipeline convergence is already in place from 1.0.1.
- Release QA and validation scaffolding is already in place from 1.0.1.

Planned for this version (sourced from open release to-do items):

- Rotate the exposed Anthropic key and revoke the current value. (OpenAI and Groq were dropped
  entirely on 2026-10-06 — Arete is Anthropic-only; nothing to rotate there.)
- Mapbox removed entirely on 2026-10-06 (unused SDK) — no token to restrict or rotate.
- Publish hosted Privacy Policy and Terms URLs and wire App Store metadata to those URLs.
- Validate OAuth callback, session restore, sign-out, and cold-launch session behavior end to end.
- Replace placeholder subscription product IDs with final App Store Connect IDs. (Done in substance: the
  four App Store Connect products use the code's IDs; prices, group levels and the Paid Apps Agreement remain.)
- Validate subscription state persistence consistency across authentication paths.
- Run runtime QA for refactored method screens (drawing, picture, and audio flows).
- Product polish and stability improvements from v1 telemetry and QA findings.
- UX consistency refinements across existing core surfaces.
- Additional progression and Arete tuning without expanding to new major surfaces.

Out of scope for this version:

- Groups reactivation and groups follow-up validation (moved to 2.0.0).

Open items:

- Define launch criteria and lock feature set.
- Add final acceptance checklist for this version.

### 2.0.0 (Planned Next Major)

Status: planned

Target window: Q4 2026+ target

Release owner: community features owner (TBD by team)

Changelog:

Completed pre-work before version start:

- Groups backend security hardening and secure membership flows are already landed.
- Groups codepath remains in repository and build target while hidden from active v1 navigation.

Planned for this version:

- Reintroduce Groups as an active product surface.
- Enable end-to-end group lifecycle: discovery, join, participate, and leave.
- Group chat and ranking experiences tied to finalized v2 product semantics.
- Community features aligned with progression and Arete guidance loops.
- Close groups follow-up validation items for leaderboard accuracy and chat prompt integration.

Open items:

- Finalize migration and rollout strategy.
